Enterprise Voice Architect | Operations Management | VOIP Infrastructure Operations VOIP Network Solution Architecture | Delivery Operations | Process Operations & Implementation | Cloud Technology Services | User & Vendor Management | Stakeholder Management | Maintenance and Support | Team Building and Management | Automation

Techno-Commercial Professional | 19+ Years of Expertise in Technical Solutions & Strategy Results-oriented professional with over 20+ years of experience in VoIP, IP Telephony & Cloud applications in UC and CC and aligning technical solution strategies with business objectives to enhance value propositions. Proven ability to develop innovative, high-level designs (HLDs) for advanced services and offerings, with expertise in Data and Voice Networks. Adept at IT governance, organizational modelling, and outsourcing, with a history of crafting technical solutions precisely tailored to customer needs through in-depth requirement analysis, complex issue resolution, and scalable solution proposals. Skilled in developing HLD solutions and cost estimations for diverse projects—ranging from straightforward initiatives to complex, long-term engagements—regularly exceeding client expectations and addressing key business challenges. Known for a powerful combination of technical insight and business acumen, consistently driving impactful strategies with cost-effective, high-performance IT infrastructure and applications. Comprehensive expertise across IT domains, including Network Infrastructure Management, underpins a track record of value creation and successful project outcomes.

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

➥ Excelled in understanding intricate client landscapes and planning strategic solutions to enhance service quality.

➥ Expert level proficiency in implementing and supporting MS Teams, Avaya Contact Center (CC), Genesys Pure Engage & Genesys Pure

Cloud solutions.

➥ Achieved operational excellence and fostered a results-driven culture through effective leadership in operations and people

management, consistently delivering measurable outcomes.

➥ Demonstrated strong leadership, interpersonal, and team-building capabilities, contributing to high-performing teams. Leveraged a diverse techno-commercial background to streamline resource management, optimize processes, and drive operational efficiency.

CORE COMPETENCIES

➥ VoIP Architecture Design (SIP, ISDN, IP PBX, Audio Codes SBCs)

➥ Network Infrastructure (LAN/WAN, SDN, Firewalls, QoS, MPLS, BGP, Load Balancer)

➥ Unified Communications (Cisco Call Manager, Avaya, Microsoft Teams, Genesys, Zoom) ➥ Software/Tools (Cisco Call Manager, Avaya Communication Manager, MS Teams, Grafana, Raspberry Pi, Solar Wind)

➥ Project Management (Stakeholder Engagement, Budgeting, Scheduling)

➥ IT Governance & Compliance (ITIL, ISO, Data Security) ➥ Technical Solution Strategy (HLD/LLD, Requirement Analysis, Optimization, Cost Optimization)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

BlackBox, Bangalore Principal Consultant ➥ Led end-to-end technical engagements for VoIP, UCaaS, and Contact Center solutions across Avaya, Genesys, Zoom, and Microsoft

July 2025 - Present

Teams platforms for enterprise clients.

➥ Engaged with customers to discover business and technical requirements, assess existing telephony environments, and translate

needs into scalable voice, video, and omnichannel architectures.

➥ Architected secure, high-availability VoIP solutions including SIP trunking, PBX, SBCs, IVR, call routing, QoS, redundancy, and

disaster recovery aligned to business goals.

➥ Designed and delivered cloud, hybrid, and on-prem UC/CC solutions, including Avaya Aura, Genesys Cloud/CX, Zoom Phone, and

Teams Phone, ensuring performance and compliance.

➥ Produced HLD/LLD, call flows, network diagrams, BOMs, and cost estimates, ensuring alignment with customer budgets,

regulatory standards, and enterprise architecture guidelines. Led RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, technical workshops, solution presentations, product demos, and proof-of-concept (PoC) validations to demonstrate solution value and feasibility.

➥ Collaborated closely with sales, delivery, product, and partner teams to develop competitive proposals, pricing strategies, and

value propositions that improved win rates.

➥ Integrated VoIP and UC solutions with enterprise applications and CRMs such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Dynamics, and custom

APIs to enable seamless business workflows.

➥ Advised customers on network readiness, bandwidth planning, security, regulatory compliance, and legacy PBX migration

strategies to modern cloud or hybrid platforms.

➥ Drove deal success and revenue growth through strong technical storytelling, continuous enablement, identification of upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and adoption of next-generation features such as AI, analytics, recording, and workforce engagement.

Hewlett-Packard, Bangalore Sr Global VoIP Solution Architect ➥ Spearheaded the design, development, and deployment of global VoIP Network Solutions for multinational clients, ensuring seamless

April 2021 – June 2025

alignment with business objectives, budget constraints, and technical prerequisites.

➥ Fostered collaboration with cross-functional teams to elicit requirements, devise architecture, and execute VoIP Network Solutions

harmonized with organizational goals.

➥ Engineered scalable and resilient VoIP networks leveraging cutting-edge technologies like SIP, VoIP, PBX, and cloud-based platforms. ➥ Led the migration of legacy on-premises telephony systems to Microsoft Teams Cloud Voice, leveraging AudioCodes Session Border

Controllers (SBCs) for secure and seamless integration.

➥ Planned and designed global connectivity between Contact Centers, remote users, and Genesys AWS regions using SD-WAN, MPLS, and VPN. Deployed regional SBCs, integrated with Genesys SBCs, and partnered with cybersecurity experts to ensure compliance with in- country telecom regulations to enhance voice network performance (latency, jitter).

➥ Managed VoIP inventory, optimized operational costs, and oversaw vendor relationships to ensure service efficiency and cost-

effectiveness.

➥ Collaborated with carriers (BT, Verizon, TATA, China Mobile) for BYOC/SIP trunk deployments using Genesys Global Media Fabric and

WebRTC for agent softphones. Managed inbound voice routing with TFNs, ITFNs, and DIDs.

➥ Produced comprehensive documentation encompassing technical specifications, architectural diagrams, and operational procedures to

streamline system understanding and maintenance.

➥ Conducted regular performance evaluations and optimizations to uphold superior voice quality and reliability standards. ➥ Led periodic performance assessments and audits of voice systems, pinpointing enhancement opportunities and proactively

implementing measures to fortify reliability, scalability, and security.

➥ Collaborated closely with vendors and third-party providers to secure essential hardware and software components essential for

seamless system operation.

➥ Delivered ongoing support and swift troubleshooting for voice systems, ensuring timely issue resolution to minimize operational

downtime.

➥ Skilfully communicated complex architecture strategies to senior leadership and third-party business leaders using visual

representations. Facilitated key stakeholder decision-making processes, resulting in well-informed and timely choices.

iOPEX Technologies, Bangalore Voice Specialist ➥ Directed the configuration, deployment, and upkeep of voice communication systems, including PBX, VoIP, and SIP technologies,

December 2020 – April 2021

ensuring seamless operations and peak performance.

➥ Conducted comprehensive evaluations of existing voice infrastructure, pinpointing areas for enhancement and executing

improvements to bolster efficiency and reliability.

➥ Led requirements gathering sessions with clients to discern business objectives, technical constraints, and user needs, subsequently

translating requirements into actionable design specifications.

➥ Played a pivotal role in troubleshooting and rectifying voice system issues, offering timely support to mitigate disruptions and maintain

uninterrupted communication services.

➥ Collaborated closely with sales and marketing teams to craft technical proposals, presentations, and demonstrations for prospective

clients, effectively showcasing the value proposition of voice solutions.

➥ Provided comprehensive training and guidance to end-users on voice communication systems, fostering user adoption and optimizing

system utilization.

➥ Stayed abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends in voice communication, integrating relevant advancements to optimize

system performance and capabilities.

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE

AT&T – Bangalore | Specialist IBM India Private Limited - Bangalore| System Operation Senior Specialist Vitage Technologies Private Limited – Bangalore | Executive Support

Aug 2008 - Dec 2020 Mar 2007 - Jul 2008 Jun 2006 - Mar 2007

KEY PROJECTS

➥ Global VoIP Migration Project

Architected and executed a full-scale VoIP migration (Skype->MS Teams & Genesys Pure Engage->Genesys Pure Cloud) for HPe, resulting in a 75% reduction in telecom expenses and 100% improvement in call quality and system uptime.

➥ IT NOC Deployment

Designed and deployed end-to-end IT NOC monitoring solutions integrating Grafana, SolarWinds, and Raspberry Pi-based edge devices, enabling real-time infrastructure visibility and improving incident response efficiency by 99%.

➥ Disaster Recovery Implementation

Designed and deployed a VoIP disaster recovery plan, ensuring zero downtime and continuity of service during unforeseen events.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s in Technology (B. Tech) in Information Technology - Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha

CERTIFICATIONS

➥ ITIL V3 (Foundation) ➥ CCNA ➥ Avaya Certified Associate ➥ CCNP Voice ➥ Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals ➥ Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals ➥ Zoom Certified – ZSA Zoom Foundations ➥ Zoom Certified – ZDA Zoom Phone Deployment Advanced
